claim: does design/divider/divider_intN.sch (the standalone programmable integer-N feedback divider, issue #27, retimed to a dual-modulus /2-/3 prescaler front-end by issue #114) divide a fixed 250 MHz ideal CLK by N=63 (NSEL[5:0]=111110) cleanly. N=63 is the largest *odd* modulus in the DRAFT range (spec/target-spec.md row 4, N = 4-64) -- the odd decode path exercises exactly one /3 prescaler period per output period (ODD=1) combined with the widest reload word (L=30), together the largest-depth odd-path case the decode reaches. This is a design-input measurement, not a spec/target-spec.md ratification: row 4 stays DRAFT -- per CLAUDE.md, ratification is a separate decision-record act argued on its own merits. **Spec row(s)**: 4 (DRAFT target N = 4-64, static configuration -- this record supplies evidence toward that row, not a verdict on it).
methodology_note: this testbench's DUT is design/divider/divider_intN.sch driven open-loop (no VCO, PFD/charge pump or loop filter in the path) -- CLK is an ideal rail-to-rail pulse source (12.5 ps edges, 4 ns period = 250 MHz, 50% duty, the design's own lock target) instead of the real VCO's output, and NSEL[5:0]=111110 (N=63) is strapped statically via lab_pin ties to VDD/GND. RESETB is released by a pwl at 5-6 ns (design/divider/DESIGN.md's own issue #114 diagnostic method). `measure.lock`'s target_hz (3968253.97 Hz = f_CLK/N = 250 MHz/63) plus a 2% tolerance and a 5-output-period window/hold reproduces design/divider/DESIGN.md's own issue #114 pass criterion, applied via the harness's general-purpose sliding-window lock detector. `require_lock` is true. process_corners is the ratified rows 19/20 PVT grid (spec/target-spec.md, DR-003, #77) -- this manifest declares the same full 5-corner x 3-temp x 3-supply default grid every other sim/ manifest in this repo declares, but issue #129 only asks for the two named corners here (tt/27 degC/1.80 V and ss/125 degC/1.62 V) at minimum -- N=63's 252 ns output period makes its per-point cost comparable to sim/divider-n64's (see that manifest's own methodology_note for the measured ~0.89 s/simulated-ns rate this harness costs), so a full 45-point grid is not attempted here; issue #130 tracks widening this manifest's grid alongside sim/divider-n64's, if wanted. This record's own Corner matrix run / subset-reason field states exactly which points were run.
analysis: transient, standalone divider (`tran 40p 3200n`, injected by sim/harness/measure.py from this manifest's own measure block -- see sim/divider-n63/testbench/tb_divider_n63.sch's header comment for why the schematic itself carries no .tran card). The 3.2 us window covers roughly 12.7 output periods at the target frequency (3.968 MHz, 252 ns/period) after RESETB releases at 6 ns -- more than the 11 edges (window_cycles + 1 + min_hold_cycles) the lock criterion needs.
